// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/integration-drivers: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export interface CliApiBridge {
    origin: string;
    paths: readonly RegExp[];
    args(url: URL): string[];
    response(output: unknown): {
        status: number;
        body: unknown;
    };
}

export type CliDistribution = {
    kind: "npm" | "python";
    package: string;
    entrypoint?: string;
} | CliNativeDistribution | {
    kind: "powershell";
    module: string;
    runtime: CliNativeDistribution;
};

export interface CliDriver {
    binary: string;
    login: readonly string[];
    setup?: readonly string[];
    login_environment?: readonly CliEnvironmentField[];
    identity: readonly string[];
    read?: readonly string[];
    install: string;
    version?: readonly string[];
    distribution?: CliDistribution;
    note?: string;
    environment?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
    verify_read?: true;
    account?(value: unknown, refuse: (message: string) => never): {
        label: unknown;
        stable: unknown;
    };
    complete?(value: Record<string, unknown>, run: (args: readonly string[]) => Promise<unknown>, refuse: (message: string) => never): Promise<void>;
    api?: CliApiBridge;
}

export interface CliEnvironmentField {
    name: string;
    label: string;
    secret: boolean;
}

export interface CliNativeDistribution {
    kind: "native";
    resolve(version: string, port: CliReleasePort, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<CliNativeSource>;
}

export interface CliNativeSource {
    kind: "native";
    package: string;
    version: string;
    bin: string;
    url: string;
    sha256: string;
    entry?: string;
}

export interface CliReleasePort {
    bytes(url: string, limit: number, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Uint8Array>;
    target(): {
        readonly platform: string;
        readonly arch: string;
    };
    failed(message: string): Error;
}

export interface IntegrationDrivers {
    readonly cli?: Readonly<Record<string, CliDriver>>;
    readonly cli_release_hosts?: readonly string[];
    readonly oauth_callback_aliases?: readonly OAuthCallbackAlias[];
    readonly local_mcp_servers?: Readonly<Record<string, LocalMcpServerDeclaration>>;
    readonly public_feed?: () => PublicFeedDriver;
    readonly repository?: RepositoryDriver;
    readonly mailbox?: MailboxDriver;
}

export interface LocalMcpLaunch {
    command: string;
    args: string[];
    env: Record<string, string>;
    cwd: string;
    cleanup(): void;
}

export interface LocalMcpLaunchInput {
    client_id: string;
    client_secret: string;
    origin: string;
    access_token?: string | null;
}

export interface LocalMcpServerDeclaration {
    readonly endpoint: string;
    readonly stdio?: LocalMcpStdioDeclaration;
    readonly loopback?: true;
    readonly auth?: "none";
}

export interface LocalMcpStdioDeclaration {
    readonly package: string;
    readonly entry: string;
    readonly args: readonly string[];
    environment(input: LocalMcpLaunchInput): Record<string, string>;
}

export interface MailboxDriver {
    readonly service: string;
    readonly title: string;
    readonly origin: string;
    readRecent(get: (url: string) => Promise<Record<string, unknown>>, input: {
        days: 7 | 30;
        account: string;
    }): Promise<MailboxFile[]>;
}

export interface MailboxFile {
    path: string;
    text?: string;
    reason?: string;
}

export interface OAuthCallbackAlias {
    readonly service: string;
    readonly path: string;
    readonly project: boolean;
    readonly host?: "localhost";
}

export interface PublicFeedDriver<Transport = unknown, Routes = unknown> {
    catalog(): readonly SourceCatalogEntry[];
    addressed(): readonly PublicFeedAddressedDefinition[];
    normalizeAddress(definition_id: string, value: string): string;
    target(definition_id: string, address?: string): {
        readonly feed_url: string;
        readonly definition_id: string;
        readonly domain: string;
    };
    failureCount(cursor: unknown): number;
    cursorAfterFailure(cursor: unknown): {
        readonly cursor: unknown;
        readonly failures: number;
    };
    cursorAfterSuccess(cursor: unknown, receipt: RssFetchReceipt | null, completed_at: string): unknown;
    conditional(cursor: unknown): {
        etag?: string;
        lastModified?: string;
    };
    createTransport(fetch: FetchPort, options: {
        userAgent: string;
        conditional: {
            etag?: string;
            lastModified?: string;
        };
        onReceipt(receipt: RssFetchReceipt): void;
    }): Transport;
    routeResolver(): Routes;
}

export interface RepositoryDriver {
    read(home: string, request: RepositoryReadRequest, options?: {
        signal?: AbortSignal;
        git?: RepositoryGit;
    }): Promise<RepositoryReadResult>;
}

export type RepositoryGit = (directory: string, args: readonly string[]) => Promise<string>;

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:

type FetchPort = (input: string | URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>;
